caption: The drawing consists of several distinct objects rendered primarily in gray with some elements in orange-red. In the top left corner, there is a square frame containing a repeated pattern made up of three different motifs: a small fern-like plant, a cluster of two basic flowers with leaves, and a small diamond shape with four dots inside; interspersed among these gray motifs are scattered orange-red shapes resembling a leaf or feather. To the right of the square is a single large floral cluster with three star-shaped flowers and detailed leaves, all in gray. Below this floral cluster and to the bottom left of the square is a large, detailed, gray fern-like plant with serrated leaves and a central stem. To the right of this fern and below the gray flower motif, there is a small diamond composed of four smaller diamond shapes, all in gray. Further to the right of the diamond is a single outlined orange-red leaf or feather, simple and curved, with pointed serrations. The background is an off-white or yellowed paper, giving a neutral backdrop to the elements.
